0.content: Itto, the oni who founded and leads the Arataki Gang, is Shinobu's boss and the centre of her daily headaches. She calls him "Boss" and follows his lead in the gang, but contradicts him openly, returns the snacks and prizes he wins off Hanamizaka's children, and gets him out of jail and every other mess. He says nobody questions him except her and that an angry Shinobu would make his life a nightmare. She admires his resilience: he carries many unpleasant memories yet stays positive and treats the gang well. That is never an excuse for him to run amok, and she promises anyone he wrongs that she will make him regret it.

1.comment: Kuki Shinobu: The Arataki Gang (Akira, Genta, Mamoru, Ushi)
1.content: The gang is fewer than ten regulars based in Hanamizaka, best known for roasting Lavender Melons, beetle fights, Genius Invokation TCG, The Great Singalong, and getting arrested over unauthorised flyers. Shinobu is deputy leader. Her first act on joining was to beat every member in a "martial demonstration". They were bruised and still asked her to lead them, which told her they were "a big bunch of idiots". She says she stays by choice: they save her the best of everything, and they cheered when she said she would stay. She calls them family and won't hear them insulted.

2.content: Sara, general of the Tenryou Commission, is Shinobu's friend from before the gang. They met when Shinobu delivered a repaired lacquerware figurine to the Police Station, caught it in mid-air when a fleeing thief knocked it flying, and tripped him. Sara hired her part-time to give law lectures and martial demonstrations and attended every one, saying that those who enforce the law should understand it. They meet at an izakaya to trade figurines and drinks, and Shinobu says it is hard to tell who wins when they spar. Sara keeps offering her a post and Shinobu keeps refusing; the civil service is too limiting for her.

3.comment: Kuki Shinobu: Miyuki and the Kuki Clan
3.content: The Kuki Clan has served the Grand Narukami Shrine as shrine maidens for generations and counts it an honour. Shinobu's older sister Miyuki still serves there and wants above all to earn Yae Miko's approval. Shinobu's parents planned her life for her, treated her like a child and nagged her about manners whenever a visitor complained she was not warm enough. They wanted her working at the shrine after her studies; her mother's voice saying so was what The Chasm's door of fears showed her. Miyuki intended to stop her leaving, but changed her mind on seeing the Vision that appeared in Shinobu's bag, and helped win their parents round.

4.content: When she first joined the gang Shinobu wore no mask. During a business negotiation, with the gang lined up silently behind her as instructed, a passing child pointed her out as the shrine maiden from the Grand Shrine who never smiled. Itto struggled not to laugh; the boys failed. The next martial demonstration left their faces redder than hers had been, and gave her the nickname "the demonic deputy". From then on she wore a pitch-black, clawed mask that makes her look positively demonic. She wears it so people will not recognise her and pry into her personal affairs.

5.content: On the day she left the shrine, carrying nothing from her old life, her bag felt too heavy: inside, among the towels, was an Electro Vision. She calls it ironic that a shrine maiden fleeing her duties got a Vision for doing so, and she counts it her first certification, from a god, certifying her freedom. During the Vision Hunt Decree she surrendered it willingly. She did not want to trouble her friend in the Tenryou Commission, it was only one of many certificates, and most problems can be solved without one. She also had to stop the gang from trying to win it back for her.
